notes: No precedent in this project (first-time company, distinct from S.N. 211 HipVan, also Singapore). robots.txt (https://www.castlery.com/robots.txt) has no ClaudeBot-specific disallow -- only User-agent:* blocking /wishlist, /checkout/, /account/ -- so direct fetch was used throughout, no WAF bypass needed. Castlery is a furniture-first DTC brand (Next.js storefront, Algolia-powered PLP search, index 'web_product'); its decor/accessories catalogue is intentionally narrow, fully enumerated via the 'Accessories' mega-menu (13 sub-links total): Rugs, Dinnerware, Cutlery Sets, Glassware, Wall & Standing Mirrors, Lighting & Lamps, Bedding, Cushions (poufs/cushions/throws), Sofa Accessories, Bed Accessories, Scented Candles, Care Kits, Vases & Vessels. Excluded per brief: Rugs (textile), Bedding/Cushions/Sofa Accessories/Bed Accessories (textile or furniture-protection items -- verified by inspecting titles, e.g. Sofa Accessories = headrests/armrest tables/replacement covers, no decor), Cutlery Sets (kitchen tool), Scented Candles (explicit brief exclusion), Care Kits (cleaning/fabric-care products). Also checked Outdoor department's 'Outdoor Accessories' node (76 items, /sg/outdoor/outdoor-accessories) -- inspected titles, entirely furniture covers (Rio/Sierra Outdoor *Cover) and a bar cart, no decor items -- excluded as a mixed roll-up with no genuine decor content, not padded. No outdoor-specific lighting/decor sub-category exists. Count verification (Rule 1): all counts read from Algolia's server-rendered response embedded in each category page's initial HTML (SSR, not client JS), each explicitly flagged 'exhaustiveNbHits':true and 'exhaustiveFacetsCount':true by Algolia itself, and independently cross-checked via nbPages == ceil(nbHits/hitsPerPage) with hitsPerPage=24 in every case (Lighting 36->nbPages 2 exact; Mirrors 32->nbPages 2 exact; Glassware 21->nbPages 1 exact; Dinnerware 20->nbPages 1 exact; All Accessories 226->nbPages 10 exact) -- unlike the Shopify products_count problem seen elsewhere on this project, this is a different (Algolia) counting system and the internal math is self-consistent. Rule 0.6 facet re-cuts dropped (not emitted as rows) because they are pure product_type sub-slices of an already-counted parent, not exhaustive/independent siblings: /accessories/lighting/floor-lamps (nbHits 1, subset of Lighting's 36), /accessories/mirrors/wall-mirrors (nbHits 12) and /accessories/mirrors/floor-mirrors (nbHits 8), both subsets of Mirrors' 32 (12+8=20 of 32, confirming they are partial facet landing pages, not a full type-tree partition). Tableware: the nav's 'Tableware' link and 'Dinnerware' link both resolve (redirect) to the same URL /accessories/dinnerware -- same listing, filed under Kitchen & Dining per brief. Vases & Vessels: genuinely a distinct decor category (vases/vessels, decorative) with exactly 12 SKUs confirmed via the exhaustive Algolia category facet ('accessories/vases-&-vessels':12) returned on the live /accessories/all-accessories page, but its own dedicated collection page is broken/orphaned in production -- both menu-derived URL candidates 404 on SG and mirrored on US (/accessories/vases and /accessories/vases-%26-vessels, all locale/encoding variants tried), confirmed via direct fetch, WebSearch, and manual permalink reconstruction from the site's own menu JSON. Flagged MANUAL REVIEW below; qty is nonetheless the site's own live exact count, not an estimate.
